description: This file defines serialization utilities, including functions for converting various data types to and from strings, handling Unicode and ASCII conversions, and a nested template class for parsing serialized data. It also includes external references to other modules and supports different character encodings.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing serialized text fragments, managing parser state, and invoking parent handler methods during parsing.

methods.name: ToCharacter
methods.description: Converts a character from a string to a TCHAR, supporting Unicode and platform-specific conversions.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts various data types (strings, integers, booleans, etc.) to their string representations, considering Unicode support.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses strings to convert them into specific data types, such as integers, booleans, or binary data.

methods.name: ToHexString
methods.description: Converts a byte array into a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: FromHexString
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string back into a byte array.

methods.name: ToString (Base64)
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a Base64 string with optional padding.

methods.name: FromString (Base64)
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into a byte array.

methods.name: CodePointToUTF16
methods.description: Converts a Unicode code point into UTF-16 surrogate pairs.

methods.name: UTF16ToCodePoint
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 surrogate pairs into a Unicode code point.

methods.name: ToCodePoint
methods.description: Converts a sequence of TCHAR characters into a Unicode code point.

methods.name: FromCodePoint
methods.description: Converts a Unicode code point into a sequence of TCHAR characters.

methods.name: ToQuotedString
methods.description: Wraps a string with a specified quote character, escaping as necessary.
